description: Registry of third-party reverse-engineering and development tools installed at the sibling C:\RIFT MODDING\Tools\ directory. All paths are relative to this project root (C:\RIFT MODDING\Assets\).

x64dbg.description: Windows debugger — attach to RIFT client to observe archive read behavior at runtime

jdk21.description: Eclipse Temurin JDK 21 — required runtime for Ghidra 12.1+

ghidra.description: NSA binary static analysis — decompile RIFT DLLs to extract NiDataStream/TWAD parsing logic

blender.description: 3D modeling suite — visually inspect OBJ exports for structural correctness

nifskope.description: Gamebryo NIF viewer — inspect NiMesh block tree, NiDataStream bindings, and raw bytes

imhex.description: Pattern-based hex editor — analyze binary stream bodies, identify magic constants and struct layouts

jq.description: JSON query CLI — slice/dice large JSON/JSONL inventories for pattern analysis

gimp.description: Image editor — open DDS textures linked from NIF models to verify texture→model bindings

hxd.description: Large-file hex editor — inspect multi-GB TWAD archives, find magic bytes and compression boundaries

gitleaks.description: Secret and path leak scanner — prevents accidental game paths or credentials in commits

pre-commit.description: Git hook manager — auto-enforces ruff, mypy, dotnet format, gitleaks, and markdownlint before every commit

semgrep.description: Static analysis with custom rules — C# stream parsing safety rules for Program.cs binary decoding

markdownlint.description: Markdown linter — enforces consistent docs formatting across 30+ markdown files

sysinternals.description: Process Monitor — observe RIFT client file I/O at runtime (manual use, read-only)
